title: Lānaʻi Planning Commission return to in-person meetings
summary: The planning department planned a Lānaʻi site visit in January 2025 to prepare for in-person meetings. In May 2026 staff said the planning director allows in-person meetings but does not want staff staying overnight, and the chair asked for her position on hybrid meetings.

timeline.text: Staff will ask the planning director why she does not want overnight stays and what her position is on hybrid meetings.
Staff said the planning director allows in-person meetings but does not want staff to stay overnight.
The planning department plans a Lānaʻi site visit on January 18th to prepare for in-person meetings.
